# Cortex - One binary. Zero dependencies. Local code intelligence for AI coding agents.

Cortex indexes repositories into a SQLite call graph and serves it over MCP.
29 languages, 32 tools, sub-second indexing, offline security analysis.

Docs: https://1337xcode.github.io/cortex/docs/getting-started/
GitHub: https://github.com/1337Xcode/cortex
